sentences.en: We all felt we could relate to that because we're not about the jangly pop or the rock'n'roll scene of the Strokes.

sentences.en: The jangly guitar sound provides a security blanket, falsely.

sentences.en: Jangly guitars, slap bass and squidgy synth basslines also make an appearance, alongside trippy effects, disco strings and atmospheric chords.
sentences.vi: Đàn guitar jangly, âm bass mạnh và âm trầm synth chắc nịch cũng xuất hiện cùng với các hiệu ứng trippy, dây disco và hợp âm khí quyển.

sentences.en: For example, for a sustained B, the author of the site states that the chord has a "nice jangly sound" and that lifting a finger will make the chord sound more like a Crowded House song.
sentences.vi: Ví dụ: đối với âm B bền vững, tác giả của trang này tuyên bố rằng hợp âm này có ""âm thanh jangly hay"" và việc nhấc ngón tay lên sẽ làm cho hợp âm giống như một bài hát Crowded House.

sentences.en: A great hat or headband, necklace, belly chain, armbands and jangly anklets can all make for more fun.

sentences.en: Follow this link to check out this synth and jangly guitar heartbreaker, plus one more track from the album.

sentences.en: Dawson's obsessives will recognise this jangly, guitar-pop the second the catchy chorus kicks in.

sentences.en: Lindstrom admits to being mystified by TV ads that give viewers close-up food-porn shots of meat on a grill but accompany that with generic jangly guitar music.
